event.name: airport_near_conflict_surrogate
event.truth: synchronous future horizontal separation <= 1.0 km and vertical separation <= 0.3 km at any forecast step
event.predictive_measurement: soft separation kernel marginalized over independent actor mode pairs

alert.threshold_fit: 95th percentile of negative-pair probability on fold training scenes only
alert.lead_time: seconds from forecast origin to first true synchronous near-conflict
